instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: EdTech startup providing an AI-powered math tutoring platform for middle and high school students. Adaptive problem generation based on individual knowledge gaps. 30,000 active student users across 200 schools. Evaluating natural language step-by-step solution explanation and automated curriculum alignment. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently focused on optimizing existing product lines for efficiency rather than large-scale market disruption. Internal resources are heavily weighted towards maintaining current competitive advantages in the established tutoring market.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Personalized Learning Path Micro-Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Enhance existing adaptive problem generation by integrating real-time student engagement metrics to fine-tune pacing and content difficulty. This is a low-risk, high-ROI incremental improvement that directly addresses customer retention concerns.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on integrating usage data streams
Define KPIs for learning path engagement correlation with retention
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase student retention rate by 3% within Q3

opportunities.title: Enhanced Customer Onboarding and Experience (CX) Overhaul
opportunities.rationale: Since a key competitor is offering a more modern experience, this focuses on streamlining the digital user journey for new users. This addresses switching costs indirectly by improving initial perceived value.

first_actions: Implement A/B testing on core feature accessibility
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce user drop-off rate during the first week by 15%

opportunities.title: Development of a Hyper-Localized Community Learning Ecosystem (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of competing purely on pricing, this involves bold expansion into localized content partnerships and community hubs specific to regional curricula. This creates strong brand loyalty and high switching costs based on curriculum integration.

first_actions: Identify 3 key regional school districts for pilot partnership
Develop a scalable API framework for third-party content integration
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 10 major regional curriculum partnerships within 1 year
milestones: Year 1: Ecosystem footprint established across 5 regions

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated cross-functional steering committee focused solely on operationalizing the 'market_defense' strategy.
Prioritize and secure budget for the AI Micro-Optimization project based on conservative ROI modeling.
Audit current formal innovation process to identify specific bottlenecks causing delays in concept approval.

key_weaknesses: Bottlenecked formal decision-making process leading to slow execution (as noted by 'process' barrier).
Limited budget allocation (3%) relative to the complexity of developing radical, high-impact competitive features.
Risk aversion potentially stifling truly disruptive ideas in favor of incremental maintenance activities.
